text:
Revision 7 now has the correct manifest guards and complete bounded page reads. Preserve those, all accepted requirements, actual product visits, the real workbook-writing operation, its produced-file output binding and unconditional browser cleanup. It still passes full observation records (including selector, cursor and unused references) directly to select_search_products interpretation, despite calling that view compact in its objective. Correct this remaining binding issue using existing TaskPlan typed values and copy-only foreach; do not just change objectives.
Within each read_manifest_pages iteration, after its checked read, project the declared observation.records into separate consumer views. Each projection preserves one record per source record in order, duplicates, grouping and nullable values. The discovered record fields are kind, tag, selector, group, text, href and role. The selection view needs kind, group, text and href, but no selector, cursor or duplicate whole record. The consent view needs kind, role, group and text for the existing exact-text click; the product-field extraction view needs kind, group and text plus its explicitly supplied source URL. Keep the necessary exact href only in the selection view. Preserve all source records, including their nested per-page arrays; do not filter, flatten, classify or synthesize these views with an LLM. Use existing value/field/object bindings and pure copy-only foreach, exported through the enclosing group. Full observed data and authoritative metadata stay available as source evidence; do not send them redundantly to interpretation.
Bind detect_consent, select_search_products and extract_product_fields only to their corresponding compact group ports plus the explicitly needed shared context. Keep global ranking/selection as explicit interpretation and observed field extraction as extract. Do not use interpret for technical assembly or completeness. Keep guards on original producer metadata, and stop on capture or manifest truncation without guessed selectors. Missing observed fields stay null where the declared business contract permits it, never invented defaults.
No runtime changes, new steps types, new input interfaces, raised limits or weakened oracles. Keep unrelated tasks and outputs unchanged. Use concise objectives and the same scopes/export rules. This is a full structural revision only to add the missing typed projections and rebind their consumers; preserveRequirements remains true.
